title: parosela trochilina
intro: Parosela trochilina, commonly known as the "Bitter Apple", is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. The health benefits of Parosela trochilina include its use as a natural remedy to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of the common cold, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and act as a mild sedative, making it a useful remedy for anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents of Parosela trochilina include limonoids and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
